We are so grateful to our community, this incredible city we call home, and the supportive corporate community that has played a pivotal role in our journey. Several fully-stocked bars on board for purchase of hand poured cocktails, a quality wine selection and domestic/craft beers during public or private cruise events! blurb: Guests cruise the Detroit River enjoying views of the Detroit and Windsor skylines, live entertainment including Motown shows, jazz, and murder mystery dinner theater. The riverboat is the largest dinner cruise boat in the Midwest and hosts hundreds of events each year. It is also available for private events such as weddings, corporate events, and celebrations.
